news.t: BTC traded near 65,000 on Monday between a 63,800 low and a 65,600 high, after a weekend low near 62,000. Nasdaq fell about 2.5% and Nvidia about 4%, after CNBC reported its board is not considering bringing back CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned last week.

The dollar index hit its highest level since April 2025, the 10-year yield eased to about 5.12%, and gold fell to its lowest since October 2025. This matches the broad USD strength on your forex charts.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs had $185m of outflows on Friday, a seventh straight day of outflows.
Fed Chair Warsh gave no guidance on the near-term path. Futures imply a quarter-point hike in December. The Fed held at 3.75% to 4% by a 10-2 vote, with Cook and Hammack preferring a hike.
BTC is down 17% in November, a sixth straight weekly decline. Fear and Greed is at extreme fear.
JPMorgan estimates about $2.8bn of possible index-fund selling when MSCI removes Strategy (MSTR) at the close on 30 Nov.
Dates in HK time: US retail sales Tue 17 Nov 21:30; Nvidia results after the US close, about 05:00 Wed 18 Nov (time approximate); Fed minutes Thu 19 Nov 03:00; December Fed decision Thu 10 Dec 03:00.

news.t: BTC hit about 62,200 on 15 Nov: down 8.9% in 24h and 16.3% on the week, lowest since early July.
CME FedWatch put a December quarter-point hike at about 88.5% after hot October CPI (0.4% vs 0.3% expected) and strong jobs data.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost about $1.07bn from 9 to 13 Nov. Stablecoin supply fell a record $11.5bn over 30 days.
About $691m of longs were liquidated in one hour when BTC broke 64,000. Fear and Greed reads 10 (extreme fear).
December Fed meeting: 8 to 9 Dec, decision Wed 9 Dec 2:00 PM ET, which is 03:00 Thu 10 Dec Hong Kong time.
